meta.name: Jamie Oliver: Oliver's Twist
meta.description:
Global cooking sensation, Jamie Oliver, is cooking up his own 24/7 channel, bringing you his simple, quick and no-fuss recipes.

Shows: Oliver's Twist, Jamie's 30 Minute Meals, Jamie's Easy Meals for Every Day, Save With Jamie: Beef Chilli, 10 Homegrown Favorites
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
